facts.material: knit fabric of hemp and cotton (proportions not stated)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6110 covers knitted pullovers; chapter 61 note 1 (made up knitted articles), no exclusion applies
GRI 6: 6110.90 'of other textile materials' assumed because hemp (non-cotton vegetable fiber) is taken to predominate; 6110.90.90 Other; men's sweaters, Other (845)

rejected_alternatives.reason: of cotton line; would apply only if cotton predominates by weight, and this suffix is not a current line
requires 36 percent or more flax fibers; hemp is not flax

missing_facts: Weight percentages of hemp and cotton (if cotton predominates the code is 6110.20.20.xx)
Whether it is a sweater (stitch count, knit to shape) or a sweatshirt-type pullover
classification.rationale: Men's knitted pullovers fall in heading 6110 under GRI 1. The fiber that predominates by weight decides the subheading; assuming hemp predominates, 6110.90 (other textile materials) and 6110.90.90.23 (men's sweaters, other, non-cotton vegetable fibers). CROSS hits seen were cotton pullovers under 6110.20.20, which differ in fiber content, so none is cited.
